scenes.headline: Where is Rebecca Stone? Local Woman Vanishes Following Late-Night Gathering at Derelict Factory
scenes.subheadline: Authorities are scrambling to piece together a timeline after a 26-year-old disappeared under highly unusual circumstances on the town's eastern fringe.
scenes.caption: Police tape secures the perimeter of the derelict eastern factory where Rebecca Stone was last seen late Saturday night.
body: DREADMOOR — The search is on for 26-year-old Rebecca Stone, who was reported missing in the early hours of Sunday morning. Her disappearance follows what attendees have described as a private, late-night gathering at a long-abandoned factory on the eastern edge of town.

According to preliminary statements given to local authorities, Stone arrived at the dilapidated site shortly before 11:00 p.m. on Saturday. Witnesses claim she was last seen departing the premises alone sometime 'around midnight.' However, authorities have yet to independently verify this timeline, leaving a critical gap in the night's events.

The location itself raises additional questions. The factory, which has sat shuttered and decaying for years in the old industrial corridor, lacks proper lighting, security, and cellular service. It remains entirely unclear who orchestrated the gathering, or why such a remote, hazardous site was chosen. Police have currently cordoned off the area as the investigation continues.
